about: Hand-written known-answer questions for dredd/recall-bench.mjs over memories.json. Worded the way a person asks, deliberately NOT in the memory titles' words (Leviathan's benchmark names the entity in every question, which makes it a best case). `answer` is the slug that answers it, or null when no memory does: a correct path then returns nothing. `liveAnswer`, when present, is the slug that answers it in a real memory lane (--live); none are recorded, so --live reports tokens and latency only.

questions.ask: Can I ship a release on a Friday afternoon?
Why do some customers see empty squares instead of letters on the bills we send them?
How long do we keep trying when a partner's endpoint is down?
Which clock should a saved date use, the server's or the user's?
What happens when someone attaches an enormous video file?
A product I renamed this morning still shows its old name when I look it up. When does that get refreshed?
A user says the forgot-my-login email stopped working after lunch. Is that expected?
Excel shows garbage characters in names like Zoë when people open our spreadsheet download.
If I add a toggle for an unfinished feature, is it live for customers straight away?
How fast can an integration call us before it gets throttled?
Why is one customer never receiving any of our mail even though their address looks fine?
The night-mode labels are hard to read. What is the readability bar we hold?
I found a typo in a schema change that already ran in staging. Can I just fix the file?
